guardsgun.config.title: GuardsGun Settings
guardsgun.config.notice.notLoaded: The GuardsGun config is still loading. Try again in a moment.
guardsgun.config.notice.remoteServer: Connected to a server: this is your local config. Guard behavior here is controlled by the server's guardsgun-common.toml.
guardsgun.config.enableGuns.tooltip: When disabled, guards keep their vanilla weapons and none of the gun features run.
guardsgun.config.friendlyFire.tooltip: When enabled, guards cannot damage Guard Villagers' protected mobs, team allies, their owner, or Hero of the Village players.
guardsgun.config.gunSpawnChance.tooltip: Percent chance that a guard spawns with a gun. Rolled once per guard, so it does not affect guards that already spawned with custom weapons.
guardsgun.config.weaponWeights.tooltip: Weighted gun pool. Each entry is '<gun_id>=<weight>', for example tacz:ak47=30. Chance = weight / total weight.
guardsgun.config.ammoFillPercent.tooltip: How full the guard's spawn ammo box is, as a percentage of its capacity. Only used in Normal ammo mode.
guardsgun.config.ammoBoxLevel.tooltip: Tier of the ammo box guards spawn with. Higher tiers hold more ammo.
guardsgun.config.refillAmmo.tooltip: When enabled, guards walk to nearby TaCZ ammo storages to refill or exchange ammo.
Guards look for ammo storage when their box is at or below this percentage of its capacity.
guardsgun.config.refillAtNight.tooltip: When disabled, guards only refill and exchange ammo during the day.
guardsgun.config.refillCooldownSeconds.t: How long a guard waits before scanning for ammo storages again when none can serve it.
guardsgun.config.defaultAccuracyMultipli: Inaccuracy multiplier for gun types with no override. 1.0 = normal aim, higher = worse aim, lower = better aim.
guardsgun.config.accuracyOverrides.toolt: Per-type or per-gun accuracy. Entries are '<type>=<multiplier>' or '<gun_id>=<multiplier>', for example sniper=0.4 or tacz:type_81=0.5. Per-gun entries win.
guardsgun.config.weaponPool.title: Weapon Pool
guardsgun.config.weaponPool.noGuns: Weapons are only available in-game. Join a world to edit the gun list.
guardsgun.config.accuracy.title: Accuracy Overrides
guardsgun.config.accuracy.noGuns: Weapons are only available in-game. Join a world to edit the per-gun list.
guardsgun.config.reset.warning: Resetting restores every setting, including the weapon pool and accuracy overrides, to its default value.
guardsgun.config.reset.confirm.title: Reset GuardsGun settings?
guardsgun.config.reset.confirm.message1: All settings will be reset to their defaults.
guardsgun.config.missingCloth: Install Cloth Config API to edit GuardsGun settings in-game.
guardsgun.config.missingCloth.hint: The mod works without it; the config file is still used.
